topic.name: 自感与两灯实验
topic.title: 断开电源以后，灯泡为什么还会亮？
topic.question: 断开电源以后，灯泡为什么还会亮？
topic.description: 比较两种真实接线，跟踪通电延迟、断电反向与有条件的闪亮。

translations.断开电源以后，灯泡为什么还会亮？: Why can a lamp shine after the source is disconnected?
translations.比较两种真实接线，跟踪通电延迟、断电反向与有条件的闪亮。: Compare two real circuits to follow delayed rise, reversed current and a conditional flash.
translations.自感线圈与灯泡的真实连接和电流方向: Coil and lamp connections with current directions
translations.灯泡以6欧固定电阻近似，亮度由电功率映射，不模拟灯丝温度滞后。通电对照的线圈电阻: Lamps are fixed six-ohm resistors; brightness follows power without thermal lag. The on-circuit has two-ohm winding and comparison resistances and a one-ohm common resistor, calibrated for equal steady brightness. Opening preserves coil current but reverses lamp current. A flash requires sufficiently low winding resistance. Magnetic energy dissipates in both resistances.
translations.控制稳态电流，才有可比较的两盏灯。: Match steady current before comparing the lamps.
translations.线圈支路电流逐渐增加。: Current in the inductive branch rises gradually.
translations.保持总电阻相同，比较有无电感。: Keep total resistance fixed when removing inductance.
translations.电源退出，线圈与灯泡仍然闭合。: The source leaves, but the coil–lamp loop stays closed.
translations.断开前线圈电流更大，才可能暂时更亮。: A larger initial coil current permits a brighter flash.
translations.不是每次都会闪亮: Opening need not produce a flash
translations.增大线圈电阻，反向仍在，闪亮消失。: Higher winding resistance removes the flash, not reversal.
translations.电流传感器保留电流的正负号。: The current sensor preserves the sign.

cues.title: 先调至稳态等亮
cues.caption: 控制稳态电流，才有可比较的两盏灯。
cues.captionEn: Match steady current before comparing the lamps.
cues.zh: 先让开关保持闭合，调节对照支路，使两盏同规格灯泡一样亮。线圈除了自感也有电阻，所以不能直接拿没有匹配电阻的另一盏灯比较。现在两条支路稳态电流相同。
cues.en: Keep the source connected and adjust the reference branch until identical lamps have equal brightness. A coil has resistance as well as inductance, so the resistive reference must be matched. Both steady branch currents now agree.

cues.title: 重新接通
cues.caption: 线圈支路电流逐渐增加。
cues.captionEn: Current in the inductive branch rises gradually.
cues.zh: 重新接通电源。对照灯很快亮起，串有线圈的灯泡逐渐变亮。变化的电流在线圈自身产生电动势，阻碍这次增加。最终电流稳定，两盏灯又回到相同亮度。
cues.en: Reconnect the source. The reference lamp responds promptly while the coil-branch lamp brightens gradually. Changing current induces an emf in the coil that opposes this increase. At steady current, equal brightness returns.

cues.title: 传感器显示上升过程
cues.caption: 保持总电阻相同，比较有无电感。
cues.captionEn: Keep total resistance fixed when removing inductance.
cues.zh: 把灯光换成电流传感器的曲线。绿色曲线显示串有线圈时的电流，浅色虚线是总电阻相同的纯电阻对照。自感改变达到稳态的过程；相同电源和总电阻仍然给出相同的最终电流。
cues.en: Replace the light observation with a current sensor. The green trace includes the coil; the pale reference removes inductance while preserving total resistance. Inductance changes the approach to steady current, while the same source and resistance determine the final value.

cues.title: 断开后的通路
cues.caption: 电源退出，线圈与灯泡仍然闭合。
cues.captionEn: The source leaves, but the coil–lamp loop stays closed.
cues.zh: 注意这次接线已经不同：线圈与灯泡并联，开关只切断电源支路。开关断开后，沿着导线追踪，线圈和灯泡仍组成闭合回路。线圈电流保持原方向，经过灯泡时却与原来方向相反。
cues.en: This circuit is different: the coil and lamp are parallel, and the switch opens only the source branch. Follow the wires after opening. A closed coil–lamp loop survives. Coil current keeps its direction, but it passes through the lamp opposite to the previous lamp current.

cues.title: 低电阻线圈的闪亮
cues.caption: 断开前线圈电流更大，才可能暂时更亮。
cues.captionEn: A larger initial coil current permits a brighter flash.
cues.zh: 线圈电阻只有两欧，低于灯泡的六欧。电源断开前，线圈中储存的电流比灯泡原来的电流大。它转入灯泡，功率短时增加，然后随着磁场能耗散而衰减。能量来自原来储存在磁场中的能量。
cues.en: The two-ohm winding has less resistance than the six-ohm lamp. Before opening, it carries more current than the lamp. That current enters the lamp and briefly raises its power, then decays as stored magnetic energy dissipates.

cues.title: 不是每次都会闪亮
cues.titleEn: Opening need not produce a flash
cues.caption: 增大线圈电阻，反向仍在，闪亮消失。
cues.captionEn: Higher winding resistance removes the flash, not reversal.
cues.zh: 把线圈电阻增加到十欧，再重复同样步骤。原线圈电流更小，断开后灯泡不会比原来更亮。这个反例提醒我们：自感保证电流不能突变，并不保证每次断电都会看见闪亮。
cues.en: Increase winding resistance to ten ohms and repeat. The initial coil current is smaller, so the lamp does not become brighter on opening. This counterexample separates continuity of current from a flash: self-induction does not guarantee brighter light.

cues.title: 测出电流反向
cues.caption: 电流传感器保留电流的正负号。
cues.captionEn: The current sensor preserves the sign.
cues.zh: 最后用电阻和电流传感器替代灯泡观察。开关断开以前规定电阻电流为正方向，断开后的曲线落到负值，再逐渐回到零。曲线直接显示亮度无法区分的方向变化。
cues.en: Finally observe a resistor with a current sensor. Define the original resistor current as positive. After opening, the trace is negative and gradually returns to zero. The signed measurement exposes a reversal that brightness alone cannot show.
